title: Dark Patterns Meet GUI Agents: LLM Agent Susceptibility to Manipulative Interfaces and the Role of Human Oversight
reasoning: The paper conducts an empirical study evaluating how LLM-powered GUI agents respond to 16 types of 'dark patterns' (deceptive UI designs). While it discusses design ethics and the unethical nature of manipulative interfaces, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or formal systems of moral and ethical reasoning.
